response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer (15+ years) with strong software craftsmanship, testing, and some low-latency backend work, but the resume shows essentially no overlap with the core requirements of this role: no SoC or IP modeling, no hardware/RTL or computer-architecture work, no GPU/AI-accelerator experience, and no deep-learning training/inference optimization. The only hardware-adjacent items are C/C++ work on a measurement IDE at National Instruments and robotic-arm tooling, which are far from performance architecture for AI accelerators. Education is a BS in Computer Science with ample years of experience, satisfying the formal bar, but the domain expertise required at principal level is absent.
strengths: 15+ years of broad engineering experience, including C/C++ and low-latency systems
Demonstrated performance work on high-throughput microservices (millions of req/s)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching/talks
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware-software co-design experience
No AI accelerator, GPU architecture, or DNN optimization background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack, not silicon performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / GPU / deep-learning workload expertise
Seasoned engineer with low-latency systems performance work
